stories.title: Maricarmen y las elecciones del 29-N, en directo | El PP veta los minutos de silencio por Maricarmen en el Senado, el Ayuntamiento y la Asamblea de Madrid

en.title: Maricarmen and the November 29 elections, live | The PP vetoes moments of silence for Maricarmen in the Senate, City Hall and the Madrid Assembly
en.summary: Spain's PP party blocked tributes to a deceased elderly woman in several institutions, while other political parties held external commemorations. Vox abstained from proceedings in Valencia.

stories.title: Los partidos incendian la precampaña tras la muerte de Maricarmen: insultos de "miserables" y "carroñeros" y acusaciones de usarla como "estrategia electoral"

en.title: Political parties inflame precampaign following Maricarmen's death: insults of "contemptible" and "vultures" and accusations of using her as "electoral strategy"
en.summary: Political parties clashed over a moment of silence for a deceased elderly woman, with some rejecting it and others accusing opponents of exploiting the death for electoral purposes.

stories.title: Última hora de la muerte de Maricarmen Abascal a los 87 años, en directo: reacciones tras su desahucio en Madrid

en.title: Latest on the death of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal, live: reactions following her eviction in Madrid
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman died after facing multiple eviction attempts from her home where she had lived for 71 years, sparking public reactions.

stories.title: Alta tensión en la Asamblea por la muerte de Maricarmen: el PP de Ayuso denuncia "amenazas físicas" después de que la izquierda augure que "no habrá paz en las calles de Madrid"

en.title: High tension in the Assembly over Maricarmen's death: Ayuso's PP denounces "physical threats" after the left warns there will be "no peace in Madrid's streets"
en.summary: Madrid's regional government accused opposition parties of threatening violence, while exchanging criticism over a deceased elderly woman's eviction and housing issues.

stories.title: Bronca en la Asamblea tras la muerte de Maricarmen: “En las calles de Madrid no va a haber paz”; Ayuso: “¿Nos están amenazando?"

en.title: Uproar in Assembly after Maricarmen's death: "There will be no peace on Madrid's streets"; Ayuso: "Are they threatening us?"
en.summary: The PP blocked a moment of silence proposed by opposing parties to honor an 87-year-old evicted resident who died. The incident sparked heated debate in the Madrid Assembly.

stories.title: Bronca en la Asamblea de Madrid por la muerte de Maricarmen: “No habrá paz en las calles”

en.title: Uproar in Madrid Assembly over Maricarmen's death: "There will be no peace on the streets"
en.summary: Opposition parties criticized regional president Ayuso regarding housing rental policy and the circumstances surrounding a resident's death.

stories.title: Mónica García renuncia a liderar el Frente Amplio en las generales en favor de Colau

en.title: Mónica García steps down from leading Broad Front in general election in favor of Colau
en.summary: After weeks of uncertainty, García withdrew her candidacy for the Broad Front's presidential nomination, with Ada Colau becoming the preferred candidate for Spain's leftist coalition ahead of November 29 elections.

stories.title: Muere Xosé Manuel Beiras, histórico dirigente del nacionalismo gallego

en.title: Xosé Manuel Beiras, historic leader of Galician nationalism, dies
en.summary: Xosé Manuel Beiras Torrado, a prominent figure in Galician nationalism and economist, died at age 90 at his home in Brión.

stories.title: La izquierda madrileña guarda un minuto de silencio por Maricarmen en la Asamblea

en.title: Madrid's left wing observes a minute of silence for Maricarmen in the Assembly
en.summary: Legislators from Más Madrid and the Socialist Party held a minute of silence in the Madrid Assembly to honor Maricarmen, a woman whose death has become significant in housing rights debates. The People's Party, holding an absolute majority, did not participate in the tribute.

stories.title: Colau ejerce de líder del Frente Amplio: ofrece a Podemos un "papel" y "visibilidad" para pactar y le avisa de que "hay vidas en juego como la de Maricarmen"

en.title: Colau acts as leader of the Broad Front: offers Podemos a "role" and "visibility" to negotiate and warns that "lives are at stake like Maricarmen's"
en.summary: The former mayor is seeking to negotiate an agreement with Podemos before officially announcing her candidacy, emphasizing the urgency of political alliance while referencing the housing crisis affecting citizens.

stories.title: Colau se abre a liderar la izquierda alternativa, pero exige que sea un frente “realmente amplio”

en.title: Colau opens up to leading the alternative left, but demands a "genuinely broad" front
en.summary: The former mayor conditions her leadership on including Podemos and other political forces, stating she is not necessary to repeat previous political arrangements.

stories.title: Colau condiciona su liderazgo en Frente Amplio a sumar a Podemos y más fuerzas: “Para repetir experiencias anteriores yo no soy necesaria”

en.title: Colau conditions her leadership in Broad Front on adding Podemos and more forces: "To repeat previous experiences I am not necessary"
en.summary: The former mayor publicly addresses the proposal for the first time, requiring a broader political alliance with a single ballot as a condition for her candidacy.

en.title: Ibex loses 19,000 points
en.summary: Pressure from debt and oil markets persists but stabilizes. The Ibex index attempts to maintain support above the 19,000-point level after recent market declines.

stories.title: ¿Vender o seguir alquilando? El cálculo fiscal que cambia tras el nuevo decreto de vivienda

en.title: Sell or keep renting? The tax calculation that changes after the new housing decree
en.summary: A new government housing reform introduces changes to tenant indemnities and property tax exemptions, requiring private landlords to reassess their financial strategies regarding rental or sale decisions.

stories.title: Tres días de "tensa espera" en el mercado antes de tres semanas de traca

en.title: Three days of "tense waiting" in the market before three weeks of activity
en.summary: Market tension rises with government debt as a renewed focus of concern. Financial markets face three days of uncertainty followed by three weeks of significant scheduled events.

stories.title: UBE cierra su planta de ciclohexanona y pierde 8,5 millones

en.title: UBE closes its cyclohexanone plant and loses 8.5 million
en.summary: UBE closes a cyclohexanone production facility and incurs an 8.5 million loss. The company's business revenue declined 8.4 percent to 467 million euros despite positive operating results.

stories.title: Cómo descifrar el impacto de la deuda y el dólar sobre el bitcoin

en.title: How to decipher the impact of debt and the dollar on bitcoin
en.summary: Debt and dollar movements are influencing the direction of the cryptocurrency market. Analysts note that bitcoin exhibits unstable and variable correlations depending on market conditions.
